noticias.titular: Polycam convierte objetos y espacios en modelos 3D con la cámara del móvil
noticias.entradilla: La aplicación escanea lo que hay delante y genera un modelo que se puede girar, medir y compartir. Su plan gratuito tiene límites claros.
noticias.imagen_alt: Antes y después: a la izquierda, una escultura sobre una mesa rodeada por una línea de puntos que recorre un móvil, con el rótulo «Escaneo»; a la derecha, la misma figura como malla de puntos y líneas en una pantalla, con una flecha de giro y una línea de medida en rojo, con los rótulos «Modelo 3D» y «Medida».

noticias.titular: Stanford gathers 52 causal studies on AI in schools and sees uneven results
noticias.entradilla: The November review goes from 20 to 52 studies and concludes that AI looks more promising for understanding new material than for producing assignments, but no use improves learning consistently.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a person uses an assistant, from which two paths lead: one towards “Understand” and another, in red, towards “Do the task”, and at the end a balance. Labels: Assistant, Understand, Do the task, Uneven.

noticias.titular: Galicia’s parliament passes the law regulating phones, screens and AI in classrooms
noticias.entradilla: The Digital Education Law limits individual use of devices up to the fifth year of primary school and was passed with the votes of the PPdeG and the opposition of the BNG and the PSdeG.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a parliament building leads to a law, from which come a phone crossed out in red and a video camera. Labels: Parliament, Digital law, Phones, No recording.

noticias.titular: Madrid adds to EducaMadrid an AI agent that prepares personalised materials
noticias.entradilla: According to the Community of Madrid, the agent was developed by civil servants in its regional digital ministry and can be used by teachers in publicly funded schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a teacher uses an agent, from which three results come: a document, a tick and an envelope. Labels: Teacher, Agent, Notes, Quizzes, Emails.

noticias.titular: Experiment with 400 adults finds a Socratic AI tutor teaches more than explaining the mistake
noticias.entradilla: Carnegie Mellon researchers compare four ways of giving feedback after a mistake and suggest that what works is sending the student back to the task until they get it right.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two paths after a mistake, marked with a red cross. At the top, the mistake leads to a box labelled “Explanation” and from there to the next problems. At the bottom, the mistake leads to “Question”, then to “Retry”, with an arrow returning from “Retry” to “Question” until the answer is right, and finally to a tick under the label “Success”. Above, the label “64%”.

noticias.titular: Suno launches Visuals to create lyric videos and cover art from its songs
noticias.entradilla: The feature generates clips of up to 15 seconds and is paid for with credits separate from those for songs.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a musical note with three arrows towards three cards: a video clapperboard, an image and a camera. Labels: Song, Lyric video, Cover art, 15 s clip, Credits sold separately.

noticias.titular: A teacher measures the use of their apps with Umami, cookie-free statistics
noticias.entradilla: This tool shows which features students use without collecting names or email addresses.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: an app window with a pointer clicking sends its usage to a dashboard with a crossed-out eye; beside it, a cookie crossed out in red and a flag. Labels: App, Umami, No cookies, Error flag.

noticias.titular: Antigravity buckled under demand at its free launch; a year on, it has paid plans
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Google’s agent-based coding environment launched, free and overwhelmed. A year later it is on version 2.32, and extra usage requires a subscription.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych with two identical windows. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a window with a warning triangle and the label “Overloaded”. On the right, “Today”: the same window with a blue padlock and the labels “Weekly limits” and “Pro and Ultra”.

noticias.titular: Google is rolling out temporary threads in AI Mode in its search engine: the questions in those…
noticias.entradilla: Google is rolling out temporary threads in AI Mode in its search engine: the questions in those conversations are not saved in the history or used for personalisation, according to its announcement of 17 November.

noticias.titular: Trama now has 245 reading texts in Catalan and Spanish, from the third year of primary school to the first…
noticias.entradilla: Trama now has 245 reading texts in Catalan and Spanish, from the third year of primary school to the first year of ESO, according to its own website.

noticias.titular: ChatGPT Learn publishes a guide to giving tasks to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in Codex, OpenAI’s programming…
noticias.entradilla: ChatGPT Learn publishes a guide to giving tasks to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in Codex, OpenAI’s programming assistant; the page does not state a launch date or plans.

noticias.titular: Kling AI announces Kling Image 4.0, with images generated directly in 8K resolution, text in several…
noticias.entradilla: Kling AI announces Kling Image 4.0, with images generated directly in 8K resolution, text in several languages and up to 10 mutually consistent images per request, according to its statement of 17 November; it does not state availability or prices.

noticias.titular: Gemini Notebook turns a notebook’s sources into an interactive website
noticias.entradilla: All it takes is typing “make me a site” in the notebook’s chat. Members of the groups have already tried it, and one has uploaded the result to Moodle.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: three documents labelled “Sources” go into a notebook with a chat bubble labelled “make me a site”; out of it comes a web page with a panel and lines of text, labelled “Website”, which is downloaded as a “.html” file and uploaded to “Moodle”.

noticias.titular: Three apps in Catalan: a classroom auction and two density labs
noticias.entradilla: Felip Sarroca i Gil shares Subhasta, for working on scarcity and budgeting, and Densitats and Densitat, for studying flotation with Archimedes’ principle.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, an auctioneer’s gavel on its block, with coins, labelled “Auction”. On the right, a tank of water in which a block floats, with an upward arrow labelled “Buoyancy” and the label “Flotation”.

noticias.titular: Agente Clima IES analyses classroom temperature and humidity in the browser
noticias.entradilla: The app reads sensor logs and compares them with the limits set by the regulation on workplaces.
noticias.imagen_alt: A document labelled “CSV” passes into a browser window, labelled “In the browser”, containing a thermometer with the label “17–27 °C” and water drops with the label “30–70%”.

noticias.titular: Google Flow will retire Veo 3.1 Fast, Veo 3.1 Quality and Omni Flash 1.1 on 5 December
noticias.entradilla: Flow’s help page recommends moving to Omni Flash 1.2 or Veo 3.1 Lite for future projects.
noticias.imagen_alt: A calendar crossed out in red, labelled “5 Dec”, heads two groups of clapperboards: on the left, three labelled “Being retired”; on the right, two labelled “Omni Flash 1.2” and “Veo 3.1 Lite”, under the label “Staying”.

noticias.titular: Scholar Labs goes from a waiting list and English only to opening up in every language
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, Scholar Labs accepted questions only in English and many people had to join a waiting list. Since June 2026 it has been open to every signed-in user and accepts questions in all languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a closed padlock with the labels “Waiting list” and “English only”. On the right, “Today”: an open padlock, in blue, with the label “All languages” and the translation icon.

noticias.titular: South Korea will check all glasses at the university entrance exam (Suneung) after the top scorer in the…
noticias.entradilla: South Korea will check all glasses at the university entrance exam (Suneung) after the top scorer in the tax accountant exam confessed to using a micro-camera and generative AI to cheat. According to The Next Web, more than 500,000 students sit the exam at 1,300 centres.

noticias.titular: A robotic palletising cell is simulated in the browser and exports the scene as .glb
noticias.entradilla: According to the message of the person who shared it, the app was built with AI models; it lets users stop, resume and monitor a virtual industrial cell and export the scene for Blender.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a browser window with a robotic cell (conveyor with boxes, robot arm and pallet) and a vertical red line marking the safety curtain; a blue arrow towards a 3D cube. Labels: “Cell in the browser”, “Light curtain”, “.glb” and “Blender”.

noticias.titular: INTEF updates its guide to AI in education with ten ethical principles and a phased plan for schools to adopt it
noticias.entradilla: Version 2.0 of the Ministry of Education's guide, published in September 2026, organises the use of AI around three profiles (students, teachers and schools) and adds annexes ready for the classroom.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three cards, each with a human figure, labelled “Students”, “Teachers” and “School”, resting on a base labelled “Three profiles”; above the school card a seven-step staircase labelled “Seven phases” rises to a circle with a review arrow.

noticias.titular: Trama offers 206 reading texts with questions for building reading comprehension worksheets
noticias.entradilla: The catalogue, in Catalan and Spanish, is aimed mainly at the fourth to sixth years of primary school and lets teachers choose the questions before printing the worksheet or downloading it as a PDF.
noticias.imagen_alt: Trama's catalogue of reading texts with filters on the left and cards showing an illustration, title, school year, difficulty and a “Prepara la fitxa” button.

noticias.titular: EyeJack Creator: bringing an image to life on your phone with augmented reality
noticias.entradilla: A website lets you attach a video or animation to an image and watch it on your phone by pointing at it. The free version limits views, duration and size.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram in two halves. On the left, “Before”: a poster with a drawn sun and mountain, a QR code and a phone pointing at it, labelled “Poster”. On the right, “After”: the same poster with motion lines and a phone showing the animated drawing, labelled “In motion”.

noticias.titular: Failed for studying from flawed ChatGPT notes; today Catalonia has 45 guidelines on use
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, a Catalan teacher said he had failed students who studied from flawed notes made with ChatGPT, and the group called for literacy and rules. A year later, the Departament d’Educació has set out how AI should enter schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a document crossed out with an X, labelled “Flawed notes”. On the right, “Today”: the same document marked with a blue check mark, labelled “45 guidelines”.

noticias.titular: ElevenLabs’ video translator page advertises more than 90 languages, although its FAQ section speaks of…
noticias.entradilla: ElevenLabs’ video translator page advertises more than 90 languages, although its FAQ section speaks of more than 29 and does not mention Catalan. It states a limit of one minute or 50 MB per file.

noticias.titular: Declaring AI use: a teacher asks schools to clarify which uses are acceptable
noticias.entradilla: A teacher asks whether schools, very focused on detecting AI-generated work, explain clearly enough which uses are acceptable and how to declare them.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram with the question “Which uses are allowed?” at the top. On the left, a document with a blue arrow leading to a scale, under the label “Declared process”. On the right, a document with an arrow leading to a red question mark, under the label “Hidden process”.

noticias.titular: Chrome publishes Modern Web Guidance 1.0, a guide to the current web for coding agents
noticias.entradilla: The guide brings together expert-verified solutions and compatibility data to correct the outdated knowledge of models.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three boxes joined by arrows: a file with a clock, labelled “Old data”, an open book guide, labelled “Current web guide”, and a code file with a red tick, labelled “Current code”.

noticias.titular: Battleships in Catalan, against the machine or online with a room code
noticias.entradilla: “Enfonsar la flota” is a web version of the classic battleships game, with a 10×10 board, which works on coordinates and strategy in primary and secondary school.
noticias.imagen_alt: Start screen of the game with two cards: “Partida en línia”, with a button to create a room and a code field, and “Contra la màquina”, with three difficulty levels.

noticias.titular: Antigravity adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen and an Orchestrator mode that shares out the work
noticias.entradilla: Orchestrator combines Hydrogen with more powerful models; access depends on Google’s paid plan.
noticias.imagen_alt: Under the title “Orchestrator”, two boxes: on the left one with a branching diagram, labelled “Carbon plans”, and on the right one with a code file, labelled “Hydrogen edits”. An arrow carries the work from the first to the second and a red arrow goes back, labelled “If it gets stuck”.

noticias.titular: Seedream 5.5 promises to keep an image stable across 100 rounds of editing
noticias.entradilla: ByteDance presents a version of its image generator designed for retouching the same image again and again without changing what is left untouched, and which generates transparent backgrounds.
noticias.imagen_alt: Under the title “Seedream 5.5”, an image passes through circular arrows, labelled “100 rounds”, and comes out the same as it went in. On the right, a blue circle on a background of alternating squares, labelled “Transparent background”.

noticias.titular: Cross-checking several AIs was a homemade trick; today Perplexity does it in a single query
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, the advice for trusting an answer was to ask two or three artificial intelligences and use another to look for the discrepancies. In February 2026, Perplexity turned that method into a feature.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: three answers from three AIs that a person, drawn with head and shoulders and labelled “By hand”, compares. On the right, “Today”: the same three answers go into a single blue box with two zones, “Agree”, with a tick, and “Differ”.

noticias.titular: According to the Financial Times, reported by Deseret News, Spotify is preparing for early 2027 a paid…
noticias.entradilla: According to the Financial Times, reported by Deseret News, Spotify is preparing for early 2027 a paid add-on ($4 to $5 a month, according to that report) to create AI remixes and covers, with agreements with Universal, Merlin and Believe. Spotify has confirmed neither date nor price; in August it had already announced the project with Universal and Merlin.

noticias.titular: Intelética, IBERAMIA’s open-access journal on artificial intelligence, ethics and society, accepts…
noticias.entradilla: Intelética, IBERAMIA’s open-access journal on artificial intelligence, ethics and society, accepts articles in Spanish, Portuguese and English.

noticias.titular: AI-text detectors are not proof, and institutions propose assessing the process instead
noticias.entradilla: Programs that promise to reveal whether a piece of work was written by artificial intelligence get it wrong, including for students who have not used it, and even their own makers advise against punishing anyone on their say-so. This report explains what the studies, the European Regulation, data protection authorities and education guidelines say, and sets out a no-cost plan for assessing fairly in any subject: state which uses are allowed, ask for evidence of the process and listen to students.
noticias.imagen_alt: Two-column infographic. On the left, under the label “Detector”, a document with a percentage bar and a question mark, and three warnings (an alert triangle, two speech bubbles and a half-and-half box) representing false positives, poorer results in a second language and failures with mixed texts; below, the label “Indication, not proof”. An arrow leads to the right, under the label “Process”, where four steps in a staircase labelled “Declared uses”, “Drafts”, “In stages” and “Oral explanation” lead to a person holding a scale and the label “A person decides”.

noticias.titular: A teacher asks Codex to model Industrial Revolution machines in Blender
noticias.entradilla: Felip Sarroca i Gil says his computer cannot open Blender, but Codex can operate it, and it has generated 3D models for his website for fourth-year ESO students.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram from left to right: a speech bubble labelled “Request” leads to a cog labelled “Codex + Blender”, which leads to a cube with three dots labelled “3D model”; a curved red arrow, labelled “More realism”, returns from the model to the request.

noticias.titular: GeoBreath guides breathing exercises with geometric shapes and an adjustable rhythm
noticias.entradilla: Luis Vilela Acuña's app uses an animated shape to show when to breathe in, hold and breathe out. It opens in the browser, with nothing to install, and is available in six languages.
noticias.imagen_alt: GeoBreath screen with a square along whose sides a dot travels, the prompt “Inspira” in the centre, the session and cycle counters and the selector for shape and seconds per side.

noticias.titular: A web editor lets teachers design collectable fauna and flora cards for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: The Eco-Duel Card Generator, created by David Cordones, offers a form for composing cards with data on animals and plants, with one collection per school year, from the first year of primary to the second year of Bachillerato.
noticias.imagen_alt: Card editor with the form on the left and, on the right, a fauna card called Senglar with size 7, level 3 and speed 5, and the buttons Descarregar and Copiar above it.

noticias.titular: Gemini came and went in educational accounts; today the school switches it on or off
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025, anyone using Gemini with an educational account could not tell which features they would find from one day to the next. A year later, Google has opened up features that were then denied to them, but for students’ accounts each school will decide.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych split by a vertical line. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: two rows, “Gmail” with a video and a tick, and “XTEC” with a video and a red cross. On the right, “Today”: two school buildings, one with a switch turned on and the other with one turned off, next to the label “School”.

noticias.titular: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper presented on 12 November, has a 3D simulation for…
noticias.entradilla: Eduvers, the simulation platform that the paper presented on 12 November, has a 3D simulation for preparing a NaOH solution and measuring the acidity of vinegar, according to its description.

noticias.titular: Wharton releases Primer, an open system that turns a conversation into a simulation
noticias.entradilla: Wharton Generative AI Labs offers an open-source prototype in which a team of agents interviews the teacher and builds a simulation for students. Its authors warn that it has not been evaluated in classrooms.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two boxes: on the left, a teacher labelled “Teacher” hands over their conversation and receives a document with an approval mark, labelled “Design”; on the right, a student, labelled “Student”, talks to a character, labelled “Character”; below, a red arrow labelled “Report” returns from the simulation to the teacher.

noticias.titular: INTEF to present the 2026 update of its AI guide at SIMO on 13 November
noticias.entradilla: According to INTEF’s programme at SIMO EDUCACIÓN, that day was to see the presentation of the new version of its guide on the use of AI in education and another on how to integrate it into schools.
noticias.imagen_alt: A timeline under the label “13 November” with two sessions: at “10:30”, an open book labelled “AI guide”, and at “13:30”, a document labelled “Schools”.

noticias.titular: Conservatoire regulations, indicators and classroom games, new in the repository
noticias.entradilla: The Vibe Coding Educativo resource repository adds 25 resources this week: 13 are presented here and 12 have already had their own article.
noticias.imagen_alt: Home page of the Legis CPMDEM catalogue with a search box, filters for validity and categories of regulation, and the first entries for decrees and orders.

noticias.titular: ElevenLabs’ Scribe v3 cuts Spanish errors by 35%, according to the company
noticias.entradilla: ElevenLabs’ new speech-to-text models reduce word errors compared with Scribe v2. The figures are the company’s own.
noticias.imagen_alt: On the left, a sound wave labelled “Voice” turns into a sheet with lines of text labelled “Text”; on the right, two columns labelled “Scribe v2” and “Scribe v3”, the second one shorter, with a red downward arrow and the label “−35%”.

noticias.titular: Atlas en xogo, a map game in Galician, joins EDUmind’s apps
noticias.entradilla: A new interactive geography app in Galician has been shared in Vibe Coding Educativo. A full description of its game modes could not be checked.
noticias.imagen_alt: A browser window with a map and the label “Atlas en xogo”; to its left, a magnifying glass with a plus sign, labelled “Zoom”; to its right, a globe labelled “3D view”.

noticias.titular: Disney was going to open its characters to AI; Sora shut down before the money arrived
noticias.entradilla: In November 2025 it was being said that Disney would allow content to be created with its characters, and the end of generative AI’s “free-for-all” was being predicted. The deal came in December, with Sora; in March, OpenAI shut Sora down and the deal fell apart.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diptych in two halves. On the left, “Nov. 2025”: a film clapperboard and a coin with a dollar sign, under the label “Licence”. On the right, “Today”: the same clapperboard and the same coin crossed out with blue lines, under the label “Closed”.

noticias.titular: Microsoft unveils Classroom, a dedicated space to centre classwork on Microsoft 365
noticias.entradilla: Microsoft Classroom brings assignments, grades and AI tools together on a single screen for primary, secondary and higher education. It arrives in 2027 at no extra cost for schools on certain plans.
noticias.imagen_alt: A panel labelled “Classroom” with four arrows leading to four boxes labelled “Tasks”, “Grades”, “Notebook” and “AI”.

noticias.titular: England's university regulator calls for more assessment without AI and reopens the debate on how to verify authorship
noticias.entradilla: The Office for Students recommends secure formats such as in-person or oral exams. In the group, members debated what can and cannot be detected.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two halves: on the left, under the label “Secure formats”, three icons labelled “Oral” (a microphone), “Presentation” (a whiteboard) and “Practical” (a pencil); on the right, a magnifying glass crossed out in red with the label “Detector”.

noticias.titular: Relleu Obert turns a piece of real map into a 3D model that can be printed for the classroom
noticias.entradilla: A free, open-source project lets you pick a place, generate its relief in the browser and export it for 3D printing.
noticias.imagen_alt: Three steps joined by arrows: a map labelled “Map”, a mountain labelled “Relief” and a printer labelled “Model”.

noticias.titular: UNESCO proposes five units for students aged 13 to 15 to question AI’s answers and decide for themselves
noticias.entradilla: “AI answers. You decide” is a companion guide to UNESCO’s media and information literacy curriculum, with classroom discussions and activities that can be used separately.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of three concentric circles: “You” in the centre, “AI systems” around it and “People and institutions” in the outer ring; two curved arrows link the first two and a red arrow points from outside to the question “Where can I have a say?”. Below, the label “Five questions” and five boxes, one for each question in the guide.

noticias.titular: England's university regulator clarifies which AI practices fit its quality conditions and publishes the study behind them
noticias.entradilla: The Office for Students and Advance HE have put out a 48-page report, based on more than 300 students and staff, and a guide that translates its findings into registration conditions B1, B2 and B4.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: a document labelled “Report” leads to an open book labelled “Guide B1 B2 B4”, which forks into two assessment lanes: a closed padlock labelled “Closed” and an open padlock labelled “Open”.

noticias.titular: A tool helps apply the order of priority in admissions to Valencian conservatoires
noticias.entradilla: José Luis Miralles Bono has created a website with diagrams, an age calculator and Excel templates for applying Order 8/2026 in music and dance schools in the Valencian Community.
noticias.imagen_alt: Page titled “Prelación de acceso a conservatorio”, with a tab bar (Outline, Timeline, Step-by-step guide, Age, Reorientation, Definitions, Templates) and four collapsible blocks of allocations.
